messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert — P99 router latency breach detected in us-west-2. Auto-paging oncall.

sam k: ack — I'm oncall. grabbing p95/p99 dashboards and logs.

maria r: got it. FYI we rolled routing-policy v3 ~2h ago, might be related.

sam k: console shows streaming endpoints p95 from ~320ms -> ~540ms, p99 jumped from ~1.8s -> ~7.2s. No 5xx spike but a lot of streaming stalls.

lee p: KV cache miss rate for gpu-pool-7 spiked x10 over baseline, qlen on pool ~40 per node.

sam k: customer-impact? @customer-success

customer-success: 3 support tickets reporting stalled streams and long TTF (time-to-first-token). One customer (ACME Inc) on Dedicated flagged as Sev1.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-453 and paged infra-ops.

infra-ops: can someone dump router routing table + pool health? suspect misrouting / hot partitioning.

sam k: paste routing dump:
```
route chat.generate -> weights {us-west-2: 0.88, us-east-1: 0.05, eu-west-1: 0.07}
pools: gpu-pool-7 (cap 12 nodes, avg qlen 40), gpu-pool-3 (cap 40 nodes, avg qlen 4)
```

maria r: that's unexpected — v3 heuristics should spread load not concentrate. new decayer math may over-prioritize recent low-latency nodes in the same zone, causing hot shard.

lee p: mitigation plan proposal: 1) reweight route to reduce us-west-2 to 0.3, 2) enable eager-fallback to pool-3, 3) drain/cordon gpu-pool-7 hot nodes.

sam k: running reweight now.

sam k: `/ops reweight route chat.generate us-west-2 0.3` -> accepted, weights applied.

oncall-bot: Heads-up — reweight will trigger rebalancing; expect short flurry of token retries.

sam k: monitoring — p99 dropped from 7.2s -> 2.1s within ~90s, p95 down to ~540ms.

maria r: enabling eager-fallback to pool-3 now.

sam k: eager-fallback enabled. streaming stalls reduced, kv miss rate falling. tail still elevated but much better.

infra-ops: recommend rollback of routing-policy v3 patch that changed decayer. Who owns that rollout?

maria r: I own it. prepping rollback to v2; will roll back in 5m.

maria r: rollback complete to routing-policy v2. Observability trending: p99 -> ~1.0s, p95 -> ~300ms, pool queues normalizing.

customer-success: notified impacted customers and issued apologies/credits. ACME reported degraded UX window ~12 minutes; they accepted credits.

lee p: follow-ups: 1) add canary gating for decayer parameter changes, 2) add per-pool KV-miss rate alert (>= x3 baseline) tied to oncall paging, 3) document emergency reweight runbook with approved playbook.

sam k: action items assigned: maria -> PR for gating + revert test, infra-ops -> emergency reweight runbook, eng-sre -> alert rule and dashboard tweak. I'll write the incident postmortem.

maria r: thanks all. will monitor for 1h then close if stable.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-453 status -> MONITORING.
